title: 005 陆敏暴怒006 杨鲤斩尸
content_zh:
：陆蓉波和杨鲤在灵玉崖上斩倒老树的时候，正值午时，管明晦在凝神入定，对外界事物浑然不知。
等他醒来，发现老树被腰斩，从树干截面可以看出，是被飞剑斩断，顿时有种危险即将临近之感。
他知道灵玉崖左近有个青囊仙子华瑶崧，受长眉真人所托，在这里看着谷辰。
那华瑶崧早已经修成元婴，证得地仙位业，距离飞升也不太远，实力不容小觑。
等到李英琼等峨眉弟子来时，她会在后面策划兜底，现场指挥，帮着斩杀谷辰。
这些天，管明晦通过黑眚丝操控草木，探查了灵玉崖周边五十里的地界，并没有发现任何人，不知道华瑶崧是还没有来，还是住得远。
如果华瑶崧现在杀进来，管明晦没有任何还手之力，绝对会被她虐得很惨！
长眉真人都消灭不了谷辰，华瑶崧肯定也不行，她应该不会轻易进来。
管明晦冷静地分析：对方只斩断了一株老树，就此离开，并没有把四十九株全斩了，应该不是华瑶崧，极有可能是个路过的，肯定还不知道这里的虚实。
他犹豫，要不要继续通过老树吸收月亮精华，以及捕猎野兽。
经过玄阴大法洗炼过的草木，普通人都能看出和别处不同，仙人哪怕远在百里之外也能一望便知，知道内情的便能联想到自己身上。
只是不采月亮精华，自己只能像原著中那样，修炼到李英琼来时，才能成个身体破破烂烂的妖尸，实力连三分之一都没有恢复，最后被群殴斩杀，再死一次。
至于捕猎野兽，是为了炼玄阴聚兽幡，那是自己翻身的最大指望！
收集月光不能停，捕猎野兽更不能停！
管你是谁，来了咱们就拼一场，反正这条命也是白捡的！
当天晚上，他放出更多的黑眚丝，操控更多的老树收取月光。
既然已经暴露了，那就在敌人到来之前，尽可能多地让自己变得更强。
这样过了数日，他以为最先找上门来的会是华瑶崧，却不想竟是杨鲤。
杨鲤生怕错过了斩妖除邪，从南海一路加速御剑赶回兔儿崖。
哪知才到崖前，就被陆敏用剑光圈住。

陆敏凝眉立目，恨不能要生吃杨鲤：“小畜生，你还敢来！”
杨鲤又吓又惊，急忙鞠躬行礼，问师伯为什么要这样对自己。
“你自己做下的好事，还敢装不知道吗？你好意思做，我还不好意思说呢！”
陆敏不说原因，杨鲤更加糊涂，索性直接跪在剑圈之中，万分诚恳地说：“小侄跟随师父来此做客，承蒙师伯师姐盛情款待，铭感五内……”
陆敏看他满脸无辜，又仔细望他脸上神气，显然纯阳未泄，没有经过男女之事，不禁心中狐疑：难道自己女儿不是被他糟蹋的？
自从上次杨鲤走后，陆蓉波就开始神思发倦，她自己不知道，陆敏却看出来，女儿这是怀孕了，不禁怒气勃发。
他料定必是杨鲤，想要去南海斩了这小畜生，又想起恩师极乐真人说过自己父女今年有一场劫数，宜静不宜动。
强忍着，每天看女儿还在装作若无其事地跟自己修炼，他就觉得恶心！
家门不幸，女儿与人私通！
自己已经是修仙之人，师父是极乐真人李静虚，在剑仙之中辈分既高，又得人尊敬，被人称为“陆地金仙”
如今女儿做出这等丑事，实在是丢人至极！
这股火在他心里酝酿着，涌动着，已经到了快要爆发的边缘，杨鲤突然上门，他正好发泄，几乎一出手就把杨鲤绞成三段。
他还在猜测：杨鲤师父是不是都精于采补之术，盗取了女儿元精，采阴补阳，明明破了身，外表看起来仍然与未经人事一般，竟然让自己也看不出来？
看了又看，结果还是杨鲤元阳未破。
杨鲤跪在剑圈里给他磕头：“小侄实在不知自己做过什么事，令师伯动了雷霆之怒。
content_en:
: It was noon when Lu Rongbo and Yang Li were cutting down the old tree on Lingyu Cliff. Guan Minghui was deep in concentration, unaware of external things.
When he woke up, he found that the old tree had been cut in half. From the cross-section of the trunk, it could be seen that it had been cut by a flying sword. He immediately felt that danger was approaching.
He knew that there was a Green Bag Fairy Huayaosong near Lingyu Cliff, who was entrusted by the Changmei Master to watch Gu Chen here.
Hua Yaosong has already cultivated into Nascent Soul and achieved the status of Earth Immortal. He is not too far away from ascending to heaven, and his strength cannot be underestimated.
When Li Yingqiong and other Emei disciples arrive, she will be behind to plan and direct, and help kill Gu Chen.
These days, Guan Minghui used black silk to control the vegetation and explored the fifty miles surrounding Lingyu Cliff. He found no one. He didn't know whether Huayaosong hadn't come yet or lived far away.
If Hua Yaosong came in now, Guan Minghui would have no power to fight back and he would definitely be tortured miserably by her!
Even Master Changmei can't destroy Gu Chen, and Hua Yaosong certainly can't either. She shouldn't be able to get in easily.
Guan Minghui analyzed calmly: The other party only cut off one old tree and left there. He did not cut off all the forty-nine trees. It was probably not Huayaosong. It was most likely a passerby. He must not have known what was going on here.
He hesitated whether to continue absorbing the moon essence through the old tree and hunting wild beasts.
Ordinary people can see that the vegetation that has been refined by Xuanyin Dafa is different from other places. Immortals can tell it at a glance even if they are hundreds of miles away, and those who know the inside story can relate it to themselves.
It's just that if you don't collect the essence of the moon, you can only practice like in the original work. When Li Yingqiong comes, you can become a monster corpse with a tattered body. Not even one third of the strength has been restored. In the end, he was beaten to death by a group and died again.
As for hunting wild beasts, it is for the purpose of refining the Xuanyin Beast Gathering Flag, which is the best hope for me to stand up!
You can’t stop collecting moonlight, and you can’t stop hunting wild beasts!
No matter who you are, let’s fight when we come here. Anyway, this life is in vain!
That night, he released more black silk threads and controlled more old trees to collect moonlight.
Now that you've been exposed, make yourself stronger as much as possible before the enemy arrives.
After a few days like this, he thought that the first person to come to his door would be Hua Yaosong, but he didn't expect that it would be Yang Li.
Yang Li was afraid that he would miss the opportunity to slay the demon and eliminate evil spirits, so he speeded up his sword all the way from the South China Sea and rushed back to Tu'er Cliff.
Unexpectedly, as soon as he reached the cliff, he was surrounded by Lu Min with a sword.
Lu Min frowned, wishing he could eat the Yang carp alive: "You little beast, how dare you come here!"
Yang Li was frightened and frightened. He bowed hurriedly and asked his uncle why he did this to him.
"How dare you pretend not to know about the good deeds you have done? You are embarrassed to do it, but I am embarrassed to say it!"
Lu Min didn't explain the reason, but Yang Li was even more confused. He simply knelt down in the circle of swords and said with great sincerity: "My nephew followed the master and came here as a guest. Thanks to the warm hospitality of the uncle and senior sister, I am very grateful..."
Lu Min saw that his face was full of innocence, and then he looked carefully at the expression on his face. It was obvious that the pure yang had not been released, and there had been no sexual intercourse between men and women. He couldn't help but wonder: Wasn't his daughter raped by him?
Lu Rongbo began to feel tired since Yang Li left last time. She didn't know it, but Lu Min could see that her daughter was pregnant and couldn't help but get angry.
He expected that it must be Yang Li, and wanted to go to the South China Sea to kill the little beast. He also remembered that his mentor Ji Le Zhenren said that his father and daughter would face a disaster this year, and it was better to stay quiet and not move.
He endured it, and he felt sick every day when he saw his daughter still pretending to be practicing with him as if nothing had happened!
The family is unfortunate, and the daughter is having an affair!
He is already a cultivator of immortality. His master is Li Jingxu, the real person of Paradise. He is a high-ranking and respected swordsman among the sword immortals. He is called the "Land Golden Immortal".
Now that my daughter has done such a scandal, it is really embarrassing!
This fire was brewing and surging in his heart, and it was alreadyOn the verge of breaking out, Yang Li suddenly came to the door. He was just in time to vent his anger and almost cut Yang Li into three pieces with one move.
He was still guessing: Could Master Yang Li be proficient in the art of collecting and replenishing, stealing his daughter's essence, collecting yin to replenish yang, and even though he was obviously broken, he still looked as if he had never been touched, yet he couldn't even tell it?
After looking at it again and again, the result was that Yang Li Yuanyang was still unbroken.
Yang Li knelt in the sword circle and kowtowed to him: "My nephew really doesn't know what he has done, which made my uncle angry with thunder.
